PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY 
Fund Accounting and Investment Operations professional with 10+ years of experience across Private Equity, Hedge Fund and 
Investment Operations, specializing in Fund Accounting, Fund Administration, NAV Calculation, Trade Processing, Trade Lifecycle 
Management, Reconciliation, Fund Valuation and Financial Reporting. Experienced in multi-strategy portfolios covering Equities, Fixed 
Income, FX and Derivatives, with exposure across trade capture, validation, booking, settlement-related activities, break investigation 
and downstream NAV impact. Strong experience in management and performance fee calculations, cash and position reconciliation, 
corporate actions, capital calls, distributions and investor reporting. Proven ability to coordinate with custodians, brokers, clients and 
internal stakeholders to resolve operational exceptions and deliver within SLA.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE 
STATE STREET 
Team Lead – Fund Accounting & Administration  |  May 2022 – Present | Bengaluru / Pune, India 
• Managed the end-to-end trade lifecycle for Private Equity and Hedge Fund portfolios, starting from receipt of executed 
trades from brokers through trade capture, trade-attribute validation, affirmation/matching, settlement monitoring, 
Prime Broker/custodian reconciliation, pricing and final NAV release.  
• Received executed trades from brokers through E-Horizon or email, reviewed the trade details and captured the 
transactions in the relevant processing/accounting system for downstream fund accounting and NAV processing.  
• Performed detailed trade capture and validation by checking fund and account details, buy/sell indicator, security and ISIN, 
quantity, price, trade date, settlement date, currency, broker and other relevant trade attributes before the trade proceeded 
through the downstream workflow.  
• Performed trade affirmation and broker matching after validation to ensure the trade attributes were complete and 
accurate. Where trades were missing, mismatched or contained incorrect information, coordinated with the broker and 
relevant stakeholders to obtain corrections before fund pricing.  
• Monitored contractual settlement dates during trade processing and investigated settlement exceptions, including cases 
involving pending client payments or incorrect/missing trade-date updates, coordinating with the appropriate stakeholders 
to avoid or resolve failed trades.  
• Coordinated with brokers, custodians, Prime Brokers and Investment Managers throughout the trade lifecycle to resolve 
trade discrepancies, confirm transaction details and ensure accurate portfolio records and timely NAV delivery.  
• Performed trade, cash and position reconciliation against Prime Broker and custodian records; investigated breaks and 
coordinated with brokers, Prime Brokers and internal teams to ensure timely resolution before NAV finalization.  
• Supported trade settlement and post-trade processing through custodian records, ensuring settled transactions were 
accurately reflected in the fund accounting books, portfolio positions and downstream NAV calculations.  
• Performed pre-processing checks on trade data to identify missing, incomplete or mismatched trade attributes before 
downstream processing, helping reduce trade-processing and reconciliation exceptions.  
• Investigated and resolved trade-processing, cash and position breaks, identifying discrepancies between internal books, 
broker/Prime Broker and custodian records and following up with the relevant parties until resolution.  
• Managed investment transactions across equities, fixed income, FX, ETD/Futures and OTC derivatives as part of multi-
strategy fund accounting and valuation activities.  

Mohammad Hasnain | Fund Accounting & Trade Operations 
• Maintained and validated Standing Settlement Instructions (SSI) used in the trade and settlement workflow and 
coordinated with relevant stakeholders where settlement information required correction.  
• Utilized TLM for reconciliation and exception-management activities, investigating trade, cash and position discrepancies 
and coordinating with relevant teams for timely break resolution.  
• Worked with E-Horizon, MCH, Bloomberg, Eagle and Charles River Investment System across trade processing, fund 
accounting, reconciliation, investment data and valuation activities.  
• Maintained exposure to SWIFT messaging workflows, including MT564 (Corporate Action Notification), MT565 (Corporate 
Action Instruction), MT566 (Corporate Action Confirmation), MT536 and MT940, with an understanding of their role in 
corporate actions, cash reporting and post-trade processing.  
• Gained exposure to CCP-based clearing processes and complex derivative products, including Cross-Currency Swaps 
(CCS), within the broader trade-processing and fund accounting environment.  
• Coordinated with the Security Valuation/Pricing team to resolve pricing-related issues and ensure required valuation 
checks were completed before final NAV release.  
• Calculated, booked and reviewed management fees, performance/incentive fees, carried interest and other fund-
related expenses, ensuring accurate accounting and appropriate NAV impact.  
• Prepared and reviewed daily and monthly NAV calculations, incorporating trade, pricing, reconciliation, fee and expense 
inputs and completing required control checks before NAV release.  
• Led the fund accounting team, performing quality reviews, SLA monitoring, stakeholder coordination and escalation 
management to ensure accurate and timely client deliverables.
